title: Control Room (requires a local mini-server)
description:
Proof of concept. A control-room window for a World of Darkness campaign in Paris: a holographic 3D map of the real city (IGN BD TOPO buildings, relief and landmarks) and a live panel of units, kept in sync with a small server running on the GM's computer, which other tools (a Claude artifact) can also read and update.

This module does not work on its own: start the mini-server, which now lives in Campaign Console (see README). Without it the module stays locked: it shows a warning and changes nothing.

Map data: IGN BD TOPO, Licence Ouverte 2.0. The interface is in French for now.
